items.title: Egy új nulladik napi sérülékenység szolgáltatásmegtagadást okozhat a Cisco SSL VPN-tűzfalainál A Cisco biztonsági frissítéseket adott ki az Adaptive Security Appliance (ASA) és a Firepower Threat Def…
items.summary: Hungary's NKI reports a new zero-day in Cisco ASA and Firepower Threat Defense SSL VPN that can cause denial of service; Cisco has released security updates.

items.title: 2026-018: Critical Vulnerabilities in PHP
items.summary: CERT-EU advisory on two critical PHP vulnerabilities enabling unauthenticated remote code execution, fixed in 8.5.12, 8.4.27, 8.3.36 and 8.2.35; PoCs are circulating publicly.

items.title: 2026-019: Critical Vulnerability in GitLab Community and Enterprise Editions
items.summary: CERT-EU warns of a critical GitLab flaw allowing unauthenticated remote code execution; patch internet-facing instances first and assess for compromise.

items.summary: Critical flaw in the AMP feature of Cisco Secure Email Gateway allows unauthenticated remote attackers to write files and run commands as root; Cisco PSIRT confirms active exploitation.
